# hpe_morpheus_ansible_tower_inventory (Data Source)

Provides a Morpheus ansible tower inventory data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_ansible_tower_inventory" "example" {
  name                         = "Demo Inventory"
  ansible_tower_integration_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ansible_tower_integration_id` (Number) The ID of the ansible tower integration

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the ansible tower inventory

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
